about: Replies as a model writes them, per tool-call format, and what the parser makes of them: reasoning_content, content, each call's name and arguments (exact text), finish_reason. tools names a set in toolsets; forced_call is the call a forced tool_choice opened in the prompt (a name, or "" for the model to name one): the reply starts after the format's forced prefix for it; single_call is parallel_tool_calls: false. test_chat_reply_corpus.py feeds each reply whole and split at every byte. A case taken from a reference engine names it in source (engine@commit and file::test, or a parity fixture's case, whose text the real model wrote); where this parser reads it otherwise, note says how and why.
